fusions.name: Trampling Onset
fusions.desc: A galloping blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Chariot Wings
fusions.desc: Thunders across a cone 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Prepared for Battle
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. For 5 seconds after, you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Distant Hoofbeats
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
